description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `FieldInfo` that models various properties and behaviors of form fields within the OFBiz widget framework. It includes constants for different field types, mechanisms for creating and identifying field types, and abstract methods for rendering and copying field instances. The class is part of the `org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model` package and interacts with related classes such as `ModelFormField`, `FormStringRenderer`, and `ModelFieldVisitor`.

classes.name: FieldInfo
classes.description: An abstract class representing metadata and behavior for form fields in the OFBiz widget framework. It provides constants for field types and sources, methods to check and create field types, and abstract methods for rendering and copying field instances.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Abstract method to accept a visitor that performs operations based on the field info.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Abstract method to create a copy of the field info instance for a given ModelFormField.

methods.name: getFieldSource
methods.description: Returns the source of the field, indicating how it was generated.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field as an integer constant.

methods.name: renderFieldString
methods.description: Abstract method to render the field as a string, writing output to an Appendable.
